what_this_is: The pin record of the stanag4559_catalog adapter: the specification its record contract and translation rules are read from, cited and NOT carried; the bundle files its fixtures and its acceptance test derive from, each with the SHA-256 the bundle's SHA256SUMS.json records, carried verbatim as test data under tests/stanag4559_bundle/ or, for the record contract, as package data; and how the synthetic fixture set is built. No node here pairs a `local_path` with a `sha256`: gates/pin_paths.py's corpus is the pinned documents under fixtures/, and these files live elsewhere.

adapter.name: stanag4559_catalog
adapter.origin: Written in this repository and landed on 2026-10-24 as the pure translation layer of SC ISR 4559 001 (with synapse_cdm.isr_record and the two other family translators); the stateful gateway of the specification is not part of this distribution.

standard.why_not_carried: The specification is the project's own engineering record, kept with its bundle outside the public tree; the translators state in their docstrings the rules they implement and the section each comes from, and read nothing else from it. NATO's STANAG 4559 and AEDP-17, AEDP-18 and AEDP-19 publications are neither read nor carried: no NATO binding package is held, and the bundle's own verification records NATO wire compatibility as not verified.

bundle_files.not_carried_because: its nine object_key values are base64url strings beside a field named key, which the repository's secret scanner (gitleaks, rule generic-api-key) flags, and .gitleaks.toml admits no allowlist by policy; its values are literals in tests/stanag4559_support.py (BUNDLE_CLOCK, BUNDLE_IDENTITY, manifest_entries)
bundle_files.role: the clock and the expected object_key, record_id and event_id of every record
the record contract urn:synapsecommand:isr:record:1, package data read by synapse_cdm.isr_record

derivation.rule: A catalogue or stream record's coverage polygon is moved seven degrees east and seven degrees north (into CONTRIBUTING.md's Baltic rectangle, whole degrees kept) and revision.semantic_sha256 is recomputed by the bundle's rule: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of family, origin, change, body and security (the workflow family without body.artifact.raw_ref), canonicalised as the bundle's validate_artifacts.py does for its ASCII and small-integer domain. A workflow record states no position and is copied byte for byte.

fixtures_are_synthetic: Every payload under fixtures/stanag4559_catalog/ and its malformed/ directory is written by spec/build_fixtures.py from the bundle's synthetic records; every identifier is a test- placeholder, every label TEST_ONLY, every position inside the Baltic rectangle, and no file is recorded data.

builder.check: python -I -B spec/build_fixtures.py --check (prints CURRENT, exits 0, writes nothing; exits 3 where tests/stanag4559_bundle/ is absent, as in an installed wheel)
builder.inputs: the three records of this family under tests/stanag4559_bundle/, each checked against the sha256 above before anything is derived
builder.octets: each record is rendered as the bundle renders it: json.dumps with indent 2 and sorted keys, and a final newline
